# doorbell-js

> Webhook signature verification for Node.js. HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body for Stripe, GitHub, Slack, Shopify, Clerk, Svix, Resend, Linear, Paddle, Meta, and Twilio.

npm i doorbell-js
https://github.com/Hashim1999164/doorbell-js
https://www.npmjs.com/package/doorbell-js

Stripe signs timestamp + '.' + raw bytes. GitHub and Shopify HMAC the body only. Their event/topic headers are not signed. Do not JSON.parse before HMAC. express.json() is the usual footgun. The Next.js export const POST = doorbell({...}) is the route. Do not call req.json().
